responsibility: Provides a C++-oriented compatibility header that maps many Cell SPU intrinsic names to VMX/Altivec implementations through si2vmx.h. It defines overloaded spu_* inline functions for vector arithmetic, logical operations, splats, comparisons, shifts, memory-style helpers, and other SPU API entry points, allowing SPU-style source to be recompiled for PowerPC VMX with similar surface syntax.
